label: Kulfi falooda
note: Kulfi served on falooda (vermicelli noodles); a way of serving, not a different kulfi

about.text: A scoop or slice of kulfi served over falooda, thin vermicelli noodles, often with rose syrup. Served this way it is a dessert plate rather than a different kind of kulfi.
